\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { LHS } & =\frac{1-\cos ^{2} x}{\frac{1}{\cos x}+1} \\
& =\frac{1-\cos ^{2} x}{\frac{1+\cos x}{\cos x}} \\
& =\left(1-\cos ^{2} x\right)\left(\frac{\cos x}{1+\cos x}\right) \\
& =(1-\cos x)(1+\cos x)\left(\frac{\cos x}{1+\cos x}\right) \\
& =(1-\cos x)(\cos x) \\
& =\cos x-\cos ^{2} x \\
& =\text { RHS }
\end{aligned}
\]
